subject: MSA + Order Form: onboarding gate questions — signer matrix, PO routing, escrow
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Santos <elena.santos@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA + Order Form: onboarding gate questions — signer matrix, PO routing, escrow

Hi Elena — thanks again for moving this forward. Attaching the latest MSA redline and our proposed order form (Redline_MSA_v3.pdf). Before we route the redline back to legal on your side, two quick onboarding items we need clarified to avoid rework in the portal enrollment (Ariba/Coupa):

1) Signer matrix: please confirm the authorized signatory and a backup signatory for contract execution (name, title, email). DocuSign preferred but we can support wet-ink for enterprise legal if necessary.
2) PO routing and EDI: your procurement team mentioned AS2/EDI and an email fallback. Can you confirm the desired PO acknowledgment window (e.g., 24h / 72h) and whether you require a PO_PREFIX field mapped on our side? If you use Ariba, is there a PO type or prefix we should set so POs auto-route to your finance GL?
3) Escrow & data retention: our legal flagged an escrow exception that was highlighted in your earlier comments — vendor-initiated escrow requests can slow procurement. If you must require escrow, can you propose specific triggering events (e.g., bankruptcy only)?

If you can send the vendor signature matrix and KYC packet, we’ll get ops/finance in the loop to confirm field mappings and EDI capabilities.

Next steps: please attach the signature matrix and any procurement connector specs. I’ll loop in Marissa (ops) and Vivek (finance) once we have that.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redline_MSA_v3.pdf (pdf)
From: Elena Santos <elena.santos@novamed.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement IT <procure@novamed.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: onboarding gate questions — signer matrix, PO routing, escrow

Hi Markus — thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching our signature matrix and KYC packet. Quick answers in-line below: 

- Signer matrix: attached (Vendor_Signature_Matrix.xlsx). Authorized signer is me (Elena Santos, Chief Procurement Officer) — backup is Miguel Alvarez (VP Finance). Both can sign via DocuSign; our legal prefers an executed copy with a notarized certificate only for acquisitions > $1M.
- PO routing / EDI: We support AS2/EDI. Preferred PO_ACK window is 48 hours. Our procurement tooling inserts a PO_PREFIX (PO-VMED-) on outbound POs; will that map cleanly? If not, we can add a webhook to route to an SFTP drop.
- Escrow: We do not typically require escrow except for long-term co-development agreements. For SaaS license + support (this engagement), we prefer contract-level vendor insolvency protections rather than escrow.

Procurement_Specs.csv and KYC_Packet.pdf attached. Let me know if Kimberly needs anything else on the redline.

Best,
Elena Santos
Chief Procurement Officer
NovaMed

Attachments: Vendor_Signature_Matrix.xlsx, KYC_Packet.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Elena Santos <elena.santos@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T15:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: onboarding gate questions — signer matrix, PO routing, escrow

Elena / Markus — thanks for the packet. I reviewed the attachments and left inline comments in a legal notes doc (MSA_Redline_LegalComments.docx). High-level asks from legal: 

- Data retention and audit logs: we proposed a 30-day default retention with option tiers; vendor counter suggested unlimited retention. We need a firm retention SLA tied to customer requests.
- PO acknowledgement window: 48 hours is acceptable, but we require explicit acceptance (PO_ACK) via EDI 855 or equivalent webhook; please confirm NovaMed will send one of these.
- Escrow: our team can remove the escrow requirement for pure SaaS if a vendor solvency clause and customer transition assistance are present. Would you accept the substitute language in §12.3 in the redline?
- Signature authority: the matrix looks fine; please confirm DocuSign envelope routing to contracts@redwood.com and marissa_cole@redwood.com for countersignature.

Please see the doc for line-by-line redline notes. Once we have confirmation on the EDI ack format and the DocuSign routing, legal can sign the MSA and we’ll generate the order form for Ariba enrollment.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MSA_Redline_LegalComments.docx
From: Elena Santos <elena.santos@novamed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement IT <procure@novamed.com>
Date: 2025-08-20T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: onboarding gate questions — signer matrix, PO routing, escrow

Kimberly — appreciate the detailed read. A couple of vendor-side proposals: 

1) PO_ACK: We can emit an EDI 855 for PO acceptance. Our standard is to send a 855 within 48 hours to the AS2 endpoint; if AS2 fails, we’ll drop to SFTP and post a flat-file ack. Can Redwood accept SFTP as backup?
2) Retention: We accept the substituted clause for SaaS customers but request that the 30-day default apply to raw telemetry only; aggregated metrics may be retained longer for product improvement (we can live with an audit log retention schedule).
3) DocuSign routing: confirmed — we will add contracts@redwood.com and marissa_cole@redwood.com as required signers in the envelope.

We also sent Procurement_Specs.csv with GL field mapping examples. On the PO_PREFIX: we will continue to prefix POs with PO-VMED-. If Redwood needs a separate PO tag, Procurement IT can add an additional XML attribute — see specs.

Forwarding Procurement IT to Ops/Finance for the technical gate.

Regards,
Elena

Attachment: Procurement_Specs.csv
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Elena Santos <elena.santos@novamed.com>
Date: 2025-08-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MSA + Order Form: onboarding gate questions — signer matrix, PO routing, escrow

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding NovaMed’s specs and legal notes. Action items for ops/finance: 

- Confirm AS2 endpoint support and SFTP fallback for PO_ACKs. If AS2 is required, provide endpoint and cert info and we’ll share our AS2 details.
- Accept PO_PREFIX mapping: NovaMed will send PO_PREFIX = PO-VMED-. Can our order ingestion map that to a Redwood field (PO_PREFIX) and route invoices to a dedicated GL mapping? Vivek — can you confirm whether finance wants GL mapping by prefix or by vendor ID?
- DocuSign: once legal signs, I’ll send the DocuSign envelope link and Elena can execute. We want to avoid additional redlines after DocuSign is started.

Please reply with the technical acceptance plan and any blockers. I’d like to lock enrollment by COB 8/21 so we can schedule activation the week of 8/25.

Thanks,
Markus
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Elena Santos <elena.santos@novamed.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T14:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MSA + Order Form: onboarding gate questions — signer matrix, PO routing, escrow

Markus / team — quick ops/finance confirmation: 

- AS2: We support AS2 for inbound POs and outbound 855s. SFTP is an accepted fallback for POs and ack files. Please have their AS2 thumbprint and cert; we’ll provide our AS2 endpoint and test payload next business day.
- PO_PREFIX mapping: ops can map PO-VMED-* prefixes to a vendor-specific routing rule. Vivek confirms finance would prefer GL mapping by vendor ID (VENDOR_5692) rather than by prefix; however, we can populate a VendorTag field with the prefix for downstream mapping if that eases reconciliation.
- Acknowledgement window: 48 hours accepted. We will emit an EDI 855 or an SFTP flat-file ack depending on channel.

Next steps for Elena: once Kimberly confirms the redline text in §12.3, Markus will send the DocuSign envelope. I’ll schedule a short AS2 test window (30 minutes) and share our test endpoint.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Onboarding & Ops
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abc123-novamed
